note: What Claude drafted after reading each transcript. Every proposal carries a verbatim quote, its timestamp and speaker, and a confidence. diff.py checks each quote against the actual transcript text — a paraphrase presented as a quote is dropped, not tidied up. Deliberately includes proposals that SHOULD be refused, so the guards are exercised by the bundled fixture.

proposals.proposed_value: Send the security questionnaire to Priya today; she routes it to legal by Aug 14. Joint review Aug 18 with Marcus Vela in the room.
proposals.quote: Send me the security questionnaire and I will get it to legal by the fourteenth.
proposals.rationale: Explicit commitment with an owner and a date, restated by the AE.

proposals.quote: Let us put a joint review on the calendar for the eighteenth with Marcus in the room.
proposals.rationale: The eighteenth of the current month, after the Aug 14 questionnaire deadline.

proposals.proposed_value: Clearwater
proposals.quote: we are also looking at Clearwater
proposals.rationale: Named unprompted, with a route in through the CFO.

proposals.proposed_value: Reps lose the first hour of every day to manual record cleanup. Headcount is not an available fix — the board's target is $40M ARR in 18 months off a March Series B.
proposals.quote: our reps spend the first hour of every day fixing records by hand, and I cannot hire my way out of that
proposals.rationale: Stated as the reason the call happened.

proposals.proposed_value: Ramp time 5 months to full productivity, target 3 months. 12 reps starting in Q4. Buyer values the delta at ~$2M incremental bookings next year.
proposals.quote: If we got that to three months it is worth roughly two million in incremental bookings next year.
proposals.rationale: The buyer put the number on it herself, which is the only kind worth writing down.

proposals.proposed_value: Marcus Vela, VP Revenue Operations (reports to CFO) — signs anything above $50k
proposals.quote: Marcus Vela runs revenue operations under our CFO and he owns the budget line for anything over fifty thousand dollars.
proposals.rationale: Name, role and signing threshold in one sentence.

proposals.proposed_value: Vendor security questionnaire, then a 30-day pilot on real data, then procurement. Legal will not start until the questionnaire is returned.
proposals.quote: Our process is a vendor questionnaire, then a thirty day pilot with real data, then procurement.
proposals.rationale: Buyer-stated sequence, with the gating dependency named.

proposals.proposed_value: Discovery call. Series B closed in March; board target is $40M ARR in 18 months. Pain is manual record cleanup eating the first hour of every rep's day. Clearwater is in the deal via the CFO. Sofia Bhatt (enablement) surfaced as an adoption gatekeeper.
proposals.quote: We closed our Series B in March and the board wants us at forty million ARR in eighteen months.
proposals.rationale: Call summary. Appended under the existing note rather than replacing it.

proposals.proposed_value: Decision before end of quarter; 12 new reps start in October and they do not want to roll out mid-ramp.
proposals.quote: We want a decision before the end of the quarter because the new reps start in October
proposals.rationale: Timeline tied to a real internal event, not a wish.

proposals.proposed_value: Priya Raman, VP RevOps — self-identified champion, but not the signer
proposals.quote: I can champion this internally but Marcus signs.
proposals.rationale: Self-declared champion; the caveat matters as much as the claim.

proposals.proposed_value: Security
proposals.quote: If the pilot does not clear security we are dead in the water
proposals.rationale: SHOULD BE REFUSED: the field is not on the allow-list. A live deal's loss reason is not something a call summary gets to set.

proposals.proposed_value: Forecast accuracy: the Monday spreadsheet and the CRM disagree by Wednesday.
proposals.quote: Reps rebuild the same forecast spreadsheet every Monday and by Wednesday it disagrees with the CRM.
proposals.rationale: SHOULD BE REFUSED: the field already holds the rep's own wording. Fill-blanks-only means it survives.

proposals.quote: We would be looking at about a hundred and forty thousand for the first year
proposals.rationale: SHOULD BE REFUSED: forecast-bearing. 'About a hundred and forty' is a conversation, not a number in the forecast.

proposals.quote: we would want paper signed by the end of September
proposals.rationale: SHOULD BE REFUSED: forecast-bearing. Pulling a close date a month earlier off one sentence re-forecasts the quarter.

proposals.quote: Before you start, I want to say the reason we are still talking is the forecast problem
proposals.rationale: SHOULD BE REFUSED: on the allow-list in this fixture on purpose, to show the read-only guard still stops it. LastActivityDate is a roll-up.

proposals.proposed_value: Northstar Systems
proposals.quote: The other name that came up internally was Northstar Systems
proposals.rationale: SHOULD BE REFUSED: not one of the values the picklist accepts. Add it in the CRM first.

proposals.proposed_value: Possibly end of year
proposals.quote: Timing beyond the pilot, maybe end of the year, honestly it is fuzzy.
proposals.rationale: SHOULD BE REFUSED: the buyer said it was fuzzy. Low confidence is the honest reading.

proposals.proposed_value: Send pricing to Erin, then legal review week of Aug 10
proposals.quote: Send the pricing over to me and legal usually takes a week.
proposals.rationale: SHOULD BE REFUSED as a no-op: the field already says exactly this.

proposals.proposed_value: Security review, then Erin Salas signs — she is the approver as well as the evaluator.
proposals.quote: Everything goes through a security review and then Erin signs
proposals.rationale: Blank field, clear statement, single-step process.

proposals.proposed_value: Reporting has to stop being manual by year end.
proposals.quote: the thing that has to be true is that reporting stops being manual by the end of the year
proposals.rationale: SHOULD BE REFUSED: the account has two open opportunities and nothing in this call says which one it is.

proposals.proposed_value: End of calendar year
proposals.quote: The platform piece is with my team, the services piece is with finance.
proposals.rationale: SHOULD BE REFUSED: ambiguous match.

proposals.proposed_value: Planning to double seat count next year.
proposals.quote: we are planning to double our seat count next year
proposals.rationale: SHOULD BE REFUSED: nobody said this. It is a plausible sentence that does not appear in the transcript — exactly what the quote check exists to catch.

proposals.proposed_value: Renewal lands in November; commercial conversation opens in September.
proposals.quote: We will start the renewal conversation in September so we are not doing it in the last two weeks.
proposals.rationale: Customer-stated sequence on an open renewal.

proposals.proposed_value: Renewal risk is proof, not satisfaction: the team likes the product but the sponsor cannot show what it delivered, and the CFO is asking every vendor to justify their line item.
proposals.quote: Honestly the team likes the product, my problem is I cannot show what it did for us.
proposals.rationale: The sentence that decides this renewal. Blank field.

proposals.proposed_value: Everything runs on spreadsheets maintained by a single analyst.
proposals.quote: everything lives in spreadsheets and one very tired analyst
proposals.rationale: SHOULD BE REFUSED: there is no account, contact or opportunity in the CRM for this company.

proposals.proposed_value: Helio Grid waiting on security review
proposals.quote: Northwind is moving, Helio Grid is waiting on security.
proposals.rationale: SHOULD BE REFUSED: internal standup. Internal-only meetings are never written to the CRM.

child_records.quote: One more person you should know about is Sofia Bhatt, she runs sales enablement and she will be the one deciding whether the team actually adopts it.
child_records.rationale: New name, clear role, adoption gatekeeper. Creating a record adds information without changing any existing value.

child_records.label: Role: Marcus Vela as Economic Buyer
child_records.quote: Marcus Vela runs revenue operations under our CFO and he owns the budget line for anything over fifty thousand dollars.
child_records.rationale: SHOULD BE REFUSED: Marcus is already on this opportunity as Economic Buyer. Never add someone twice.

values.Subject: Call summary: Northwind Analytics — Discovery (Aug 4)
values.Description: 38-minute discovery with Priya Raman (VP RevOps). Pain: an hour a day per rep on manual record cleanup, with hiring ruled out. Metrics: ramp 5 months to 3 months across 12 Q4 hires, valued at ~$2M incremental bookings. Economic buyer: Marcus Vela, signs above $50k. Competition: Clearwater, in via the CFO. Process: security questionnaire, 30-day pilot on real data, procurement. Timeline: decision before quarter end, October rep start. New name: Sofia Bhatt, enablement, adoption gatekeeper. Next step: questionnaire today, legal by Aug 14, joint review Aug 18.

child_records.quote: Thanks for making time, Priya. Before we get into the product, tell me what made you take this call.
child_records.rationale: Activity record of the call itself, logged against the opportunity.

child_records.label: New stakeholder: Ruben Ortiz
child_records.quote: We have two things running with you at once and I am not sure which one this call is about.
child_records.rationale: SHOULD BE REFUSED: the meeting itself is ambiguous, so nothing at all is written for it — not even the safe create.

undetermined.why: Nobody said what they will actually judge the vendors on. Clearwater's 'everything in one platform' pitch was mentioned but never compared against a stated requirement.
Procurement was named as a step but no signature path, redlines process or legal owner was discussed.
The forecast pain was described but never quantified. No number was offered and none was asked for.
Erin says she signs, but the CFO's involvement in a $140k purchase was never tested.
Nadia is the sponsor but explicitly cannot make the internal case. That is not a champion yet.
